verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v1: waman yurid dukhūla masjidi falā budda mina n-niyyāti nilta l-ʾamalā
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v2: yanwī biʾanna dhāka baytu llāhi dākhiluhu fazāʾiru llāhi
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v3: wafī l-ḥadīthi qāʿidu fī l-masjidi zāʾiru mawlāhu bilā taraddudi
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v4: waʾinnahu ḥaqqu ʿalā l-mazūri ʾikrāmu man zāra maʿa t-taʿzīri
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v5: yanwī ṣalāta rakʿatayni ʾin yakun waqta jawāzi n-nafli jalla man yamun
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v6: ʾin lam yakun waqta l-jawāziyāti ʾarbaʿa marrāti bibāqiyāti
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v7: wajāʾa ʿan nabiyyinā l-ʾawwāhi ṣallā ʿalayhi fātiḥu l-ʾafwāhi
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v8: la yajlisan ʾaḥadukum fī l-masjidi dūna taḥḥiyati taʾammar wāqtadi
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v9: yanwī t-tarahuba bikaffi l-ʾaʿḍā ʿani l-māʾāthimi wamā lā yurḍā
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v10: biʿiẓami z-zamāni wal-makāni taʿẓumu ṭāʿatu maʿa l-ʿiṣyāni
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v11: kadhā ntiẓāru liṣ-ṣallāti yanwī bidhāka ʾaʿẓama l-ʾujūri yaḥwī
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v12: muntaẓiru ṣ-ṣallāti kal-muṣallī ʾin lam yaʿuqhu ghayruhā min shughli
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v13: warājiʿan ḥadītha lā yazālu ʾaḥadukum tafham bimā yuqālu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v14: māḥī l-khaṭāyā wamukaffiru dh-dhunūb fahwa l-wuḍū waqta karāhati ʿaṣīb
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v15: wakathratu l-khuṭā ʾilā l-masājidi subḥāna rabbinā l-karīmi l-mājidi
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v16: kadhā ntiẓāru liṣ-ṣallāti baʿdahā fadhākumu r-riyāṭu mā ʾamjadahā
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v17: kadhāka yanwī niyyata takthīrā sawādi ṭāʾiʿīna wat-tawqīrā
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v18: wafī ḥadīthi nūrinā man kaththarā sawāda qawmi l-ḥadītha tunṣarā
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v19: l-marʾu maʿ maḥbūbihi taqarrarā ʿanhu kadhā liṣaḥbhi mubashshirā
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v20: wahakadhā yanwī bihi ʾiẓhārā shaʿāʾiri d-dīni wal-iftiqārā
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v21: kadhā t-tafarrughu ʿani l-ʾashghāli wal-kawnu fī kanafi dhī l-jalāli
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v22: wakam ʿadhābi ṣarrafa r-raḥmānu min ʿummāri baytihi bilā khulfi zukin
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v23: wahakadhā mustaghfirū l-ʾasḥāri kadhā ruwī ʿani n-nabī l-mukhtāri
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v24: yanwī samāʿa l-ʿilmi ʾaw taʿʿalumah bidhā yanālu ʾajraman taʿʿalamah
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v25: biḥusni niyyati waʾin lam yajidi dhāka hunālika bilā taraddudi
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v26: ḥuḍūru majlisi liʿilmi fāqa min ʿiyādati ʾalfa marīḍi fāstabin
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v27: wahakadhā ʾafḍalu min shuhūdi ʾalfi janāzati bilā juḥūdi
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v28: waʾalfi ḥajjahi waʾalfi ʿumrati waffaqanā llāhu likhayri khidmahi
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v29: julūsu sāʿati maḥalla ʿālimi ʾaḥabbu ʿinda dhī l-jalāli r-rāḥimi
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v30: min ṭāʿati l-ʿābidi ʾarbaʿīnā yā ṣāḥi ʿāmā fāfhimi t-tabyīnā
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v31: taʿʿalamu l-bābi mina l-ʿilmi ʾajall min ʾalfi rakʿahi biʾiṭlāqi ʾajal
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v32: waʾin taʿʿalamta lighayri llāhi fal-ʿilmu lam yakun lighayri llāhi
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v33: yanwī t-tabarruka biʾahli l-khayri wad-dīni waṣ-ṣalāḥi ʾahli l-mayri
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v34: yanwī ʿtikāfā ʾidh ʾatā mani ʿtakaf walaw fuwāqa nāqati nāla t-tuḥaf
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v35: dhā l-qadru lā yafī mina n-niyyāti lakin bihi kifāyatu l-muwātī
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v36: wabaʿda dhā ʾātīka bil-ʾādābi fāʿna bihā taṣil ʾilā l-wahābi
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v37: taṣilu bil-ʾaʿmāli lil-jināni biʾadabi taṣilu lir-raḥmāni
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v38: waqaddiman yumnāka fī d-dukhūli yusrāka fī l-khurūji yā khalīlī
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v39: bidhā taʿākasa l-khalā, wal-manzilu yumnāka fīhimā kadhāka l-ʿamalu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v40: warijlaka l-yusrā mina n-naʿli khlaʿi tajʿaluhā ʿalayhi yā ṣāḥi smaʿi
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v41: min baʿdi dhāka takhlaʿu l-yumnā ʾajal tudkhiluhā l-masjida lābisa l-wajal
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v42: watudkhilu sh-shimāla sunnatāni bidhalika l-ʾadabi taḥṣulāni
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v43: wadhāka khalʿuka sh-shimāla ʾawwalā taqdīmuka l-yumnā dukhūlā fāʿqilā
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v44: ḥīnaʾidhi taqūlu bismi llāhi muṣalliyā ʿalā rasūli llāhi
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v45: wāghfir liyā llāhumma dhanbī wāftaḥi ʾabwāba raḥmatika khayra maftaḥi
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v46: wabīlshshimāli n-naʿla khudh wāmsaḥhumā min ʿindi bābihi tafaqqadanhumā
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v47: wanaqqi ḥattā tūqina ṭ-ṭahārah bidhā takūnu min dhawī l-waqārah
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v48: qad jāʾa man kāna bidhāka fāʿilā qīla lahu dkhulan lighufri nāʾilā
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v49: kam mutaʿāṭī l-ʿilmi qad taghāfalā yaʾakhudhu bil-yumnā walan yaḥtafilā
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v50: thumma yakūnu fī shimālihi l-kitābu fadhāka maḥẓūru fajānibi l-ʿitābu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v51: ʾayḍā taqūlu bismi llāhi fī l-khurūj muṣalliyā ʿalā n-nabiyyī dhī l-ʿurūj
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v52: wāghfir liyā llāhumma dhanbī wāftaḥi ʾabwāba faḍlika likhayri maṣlaḥi
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v53: wāstaqbili l-qiblaha maʿ ghaḍḍi l-baṣar wakhafḍi ṣawti walishiʿri l-mafar
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v54: wajāniban waḍʿa l-kitābi min yadi ʾaw ghayrihi waqta l-qiyāmi tahtadi
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v55: ʾiyyāka wat-taṣfīqa fīhi wal-kalām bighayri dhikri watilāwati turām
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v56: wayaʾakulu l-kalāmu fīhi l-ḥasanāt kaʾakli nāri ḥaṭabā rawā th-thiqāt
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v57: fal-mutakallimu lahu ʾasmāʾu mina l-malāʾikahi wal-baghḍāʾu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v58: faʾawwalā yudʿā waliyyā llāhi wathāniyā yudʿā baghīḍa llāhi
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v59: ʿalayhi laʿnatu l-ʾilahi l-wāḥidi ʾākhiru mā yuqālu lil-muʿānidi
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v60: qāla rasūlu llāhi ṣallā llāhu ʿalā nabiyyinā kamā yarḍāhu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v61: yaʾatī ʿalā n-nāsi zamānu yaḥḍurūn masājidā ḥalqā faḥalqā yajlisūn
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v62: dhikruhumu ḥadīthuhum dunyāhum falam yubāli bihimu mawlāhum
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v63: falā tujālisūhumu hunākā ʾidh hum mubāʿadūna min mawlākā
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v64: humu lladhīna lā khalāqa lahumu kamā rawā nabiyyunā l-mukarramu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v65: walaysa yuqbalu lahum ṣarfu walā ʿadlu waqānā llāhu dhalika l-balā
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v66: ṣalātuhum tuṭwā kaṭayyī th-thawbi qul tuḍrabu fī l-wajhi ʾashadda yā rajul
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v67: fānqalabū lil-ʾahli khāʾibīnā ʿalayhimu llaʿnatu ʾajmaʿīnā
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v68: ʾin lam yatūbū tawbata naṣūḥā wahyā llatī yaqbaluhā tawḍīḥā
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v69: qāla bnu ʿabbāsi rasūla llāhi lā budda mina l-kalāmi ḍurrā ḥaṣalā
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v70: thumma ʾajābahu biʾaḥsani l-kalām ṣalātu rabbinā ʿalayhi was-salām
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v71: jalīsu masjidi jalīsu llāhi waqqir tuwaqqar dūnamā shtibāhi
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v72: thumma bnu ʿabbāsi lahu thnā ʿasharā shahrā murāwida n-nabī muʿtadhirā
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v73: mā zāda ʾillā shiddata fashiddah taʿʿajabū liṭūli tilka l-muddah
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v74: waḍ-ḍiḥku fī l-masjidi ẓulmahu ladā qabri farāʿi mā linuṣḥi qad badā
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v75: yā rabbanā yassir lanā t-taʾaddubā bihadhihi l-ʾādābi wat-taqarrubā
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v76: min baʿdi niyyāti ṣaḥīḥāti walā tukhayyiban rabba l-barāyā l-ʾamalā
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-adabul-masjid-c1-v77: yā rabbi ṣalliyan wasalliman ʿalā muḥammadi wāʾālihi dhawī l-ʿulā
